title: Comfort Club Covered-Repair Draws on Completed Service Calls
content:
**Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements — covered-repair draw.**

## The rule
On a Comfort Club tier that includes covered repairs, a covered-repair draw settles a completed service call of the member on an enrolled system while the agreement is active. It settles the repair lines of that call posted within the month before the date of handling, meaning fewer than one whole calendar month earlier.

The draw is posted as one draw for the call, naming the call and its covered repair line with the lowest invoice position. It is recorded in the current term of the agreement, and the covered-repair benefit remaining on the agreement for the term goes down by the amount drawn.

A draw is posted only for a call booked no earlier than the tier's covered-repair waiting period after the agreement's first covered-repair grant. The waiting period decides whether a call is drawn on, not how much is drawn.

## What the member sees
The member's visit and coverage history shows the draw against that service call, and the agreement shows the reduced benefit remaining for the term.

## System entry: `post_covered_repair_draw_a854dec6`
The draw is an agent-side action. The agent unlocks the tool `post_covered_repair_draw_a854dec6` and then calls it; the customer does not run it.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `agreement_id` | Reference number of the member's Comfort Club agreement, read from the agreement lookup | Identifier |
| `ticket_id` | Reference number of the completed service call whose repair the benefit pays, read from the service call lookup | Identifier |
| `source_line_id` | Reference number of the repair parts or repair labor line holding the lowest invoice position on that call, read from the invoice line lookup | Identifier |
| `draw_amount` | Covered-repair benefit drawn for the call | USD, 2 decimal places, always positive, rounded to the cent by the caller |

### Return
On success the tool returns a receipt with: `service_entry_id` (reference number of the new draw entry), `agreement_id` (the agreement drawn on), `ticket_id` (the service call paid), `term_start` (YYYY-MM-DD, the term whose benefit was drawn), `draw_amount` (USD, 2 decimal places), `repair_coverage_remaining` (USD, 2 decimal places, the benefit left in the term once the draw is posted) and `status`, always "posted", meaning the draw is on the agreement.

### Illustration (hypothetical values)
A call for `agreement_id` AGR-0001 and `ticket_id` TCK-0042 whose lowest-positioned covered repair line is LIN-0007, drawn at 375.00, on an agreement with 2200.00 remaining, returns a receipt showing `draw_amount` 375.00, `repair_coverage_remaining` 1825.00 and `status` "posted".
